intro: These settings apply to this browser only. They are stored here and take effect at once.

systemCurrent.light: Your system currently uses the light appearance.
systemCurrent.dark: Your system currently uses the dark appearance.

accent.hint: Used for buttons, links, the current navigation entry and the focus ring. Status colours (success, warning, error) stay the same.

language.label: Language of the interface
language.hint: The language switch in the header changes the same setting.

motion.label: Reduce motion
motion.hint: Turns off text animations and transitions.
motion.system: Your system already asks for reduced motion, so animations stay off.
